fol.notes: For q1, labelled fol since 2026-10-31 (the gold paths docs/notes.txt and docs\notes.txt differ only in the separator character, so the inference as asked builds a string): the path is a String (rel_path, local) built by a firm rule from the system's separator character (sep_char, local), and fol_check reads String answers verbatim, so the two are told apart. Systems are an uninterpreted sort; uses_path_separator is a function to an enumeration of separators (the DL file's firm one_separator). Linux's membership and its stored separator are separate facts, each given up by one world, as in the DL file (q1 does not use them).

local.sep_char: sep_char(s): the character separator s is written as ('/', '\')
local.rel_path: rel_path(o): the relative path of the file notes.txt inside the directory docs on system o

sep_chars.says: The forward slash is written '/', the backslash '\'.

path_rule.says: On a system, the relative path of notes.txt inside docs joins the directory and the file name with the system's separator.
